test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word. **
solution:
The erroneously spelt word is '**Dissiminate**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options the incorrectly spelt word is '**Dissiminate**'.
 
• Its correct spelling is '**Disseminate**'.
 
• It means 'to spread information, knowledge, ideas etc. so that it reaches as many people as possible'. [(सूचना, ज्ञान आदि का) व्यापक प्रसार करना, वितरण करना, फैलाना, प्रचार करना]
 
 
• *Example: The findings of the research have been widely **disseminated**.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Dissiminate.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Nascent**: beginning to exist; not yet completely developed. (आरंभिक अवस्था, उदीयमान; विकासशील)
 
• **Malleable**: (used about metals, etc.) that can be hit or pressed into shape easily without breaking or cracking. [(धातुएँ आदि पदार्थ) जिन्‍हें पीट या दबाकर आसानी से गढ़ा जा सकता है बिना उनके टूटे या उनमें दरार पड़े; आघात-वधर्नीय, पिटवाँ]
 
• **Obsequious**: making a great effort to please or agree with somebody, especially somebody who is important and powerful. (विशेषकर किसी प्रभावशाली व्यक्ति को ख़ुश करने के लिए बहुत प्रयास करनेवाला; चापलूस, जी-हुज़ूरिया, ख़ुशामदी)
